description: Fetches statutory public holidays, bank holidays, and stock market closures for a given 2-letter ISO country code across 48 sovereign countries (2026-2027).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, IN, JP, AU, CA).

month.description: Optional month number (1-12) to filter holidays.

type.description: Holiday classification filter. Defaults to all.

name: get_country_holidays
